Date: 2027-02-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Signed up today — interested in a quick demo

Hi team,

I just completed a self-serve signup for Redwood and kicked the tires a bit today. Really impressed so far. We are evaluating inference platforms for two projects: a customer-facing chat assistant and an internal summarization pipeline.

Would love a 20–30 minute walkthrough focused on:
- model variants and cost tradeoffs
- how routing + caching can be applied per customer segment
- private deployment options (we're regulated)

Best times this week: Tue/Wed afternoon PST. If easier, send a calendar link and I'll pick one.

Thanks,
Samira

Acme Logistics
